disclaimer: General information only — not insurance advice, a quote, or a coverage determination. An Asshield licensed agent will confirm what fits your situation. No coverage is bound by this explanation.
general_notes: Most U.S. states require drivers to carry at least a minimum amount of auto liability insurance; exact limits and rules vary by state.
Workers' compensation requirements vary by state and often by employee count, industry, and business structure — an agent will confirm what applies.
Asshield writes personal, commercial, and recreational lines only in licensed states listed on the agent contact card.

auto.label: Auto
auto.one_liner: Protect your car and liability on the road.
covers: Liability for injuries or property damage you cause while driving (subject to policy terms)
Optional physical damage coverages such as collision and comprehensive when selected
Common add-ons an agent may discuss: roadside assistance, rental reimbursement, uninsured/underinsured motorist
what_to_have_ready: State and ZIP where the vehicles are principally garaged
Names and dates of birth for drivers (no driver's license number needed here)
Year, make, and model of each vehicle
Current carrier and approximate premium if you have a policy

home.label: Home
home.one_liner: Help protect your house and belongings.
covers: Dwelling and personal property protection subject to policy terms and limits
Personal liability for covered incidents at the insured location
Common topics an agent may discuss: deductible options, replacement cost vs. ACV, scheduled valuables
what_to_have_ready: Rough year built / construction type if known
Current home carrier and premium if any

auto_home.label: Auto + Home
auto_home.one_liner: Bundle auto and home in one request.
covers: Combines auto and homeowners intake so an agent can look at both together
Bundling may offer convenience; any discount is determined by carriers, not in this chat
common_add_ons: Same as auto and home lines
what_to_have_ready: Driver and vehicle basics for auto

renters.label: Renters
renters.one_liner: Cover belongings and liability in a rental.
covers: Personal property inside a rented home or apartment (subject to limits)
Personal liability coverage for covered incidents
Loss of use / additional living expense topics an agent may discuss
what_to_have_ready: Rough contents value estimate if known

motorcycle.label: Motorcycle
motorcycle.one_liner: Bike liability and physical damage options.
covers: Liability while operating a motorcycle (subject to policy terms)
Optional physical damage for the bike when selected
Add-ons an agent may discuss: accessories, gear, roadside
what_to_have_ready: Rider name and date of birth
Year, make, and model of the motorcycle

commercial_auto.label: Commercial Auto
covers: Liability for business-use vehicles subject to policy terms
Optional physical damage for scheduled units
Agent may discuss hired/non-owned auto and driver standards
what_to_have_ready: Business name and type of operations
Driver and vehicle lists (no DL numbers in this chat)
Approximate revenue range and employee count
Current commercial auto carrier if any

commercial_gl.label: Commercial GL
covers: Third-party bodily injury and property damage arising from covered business operations (subject to terms)
Agent may discuss products/completed operations and limit options
what_to_have_ready: Years in business and employee count
Desired liability limit range if known

workers_comp.label: Workers' Comp
covers: Helps with medical and wage-related benefits for covered employee injuries subject to state systems and policy terms
Whether coverage is required depends on state rules, employee count, and business structure — an agent confirms
what_to_have_ready: Business name and type of work

trucking.label: Trucking
covers: Commercial trucking liability and related coverages discussed with an agent
Intake captures radius, cargo type, and unit counts so the agency can market appropriately
what_to_have_ready: DOT/MC number if you have one (optional)
Radius of operation and cargo type

boat.label: Boat
covers: Liability while operating a boat subject to policy terms
Optional hull/physical damage when selected
Agent may discuss navigation territory and storage
what_to_have_ready: Year, make, length, and motor HP
Where the boat is stored / how it is used

golf_cart.label: Golf Cart
covers: Liability for golf cart use subject to policy terms
Optional physical damage; street-legal use may affect options
what_to_have_ready: Year and make of the cart
